dog.description_text:
Meet Mako, the handsome boy with the most irresistible smile.This sweet soul was found wandering the cold streets of New York, and while we may never know how he ended up there, we do know one thing for certain: Mako deserves a loving home.

Mako is incredibly gentle, affectionate, and full of love. Friendly and easygoing, he just wants to be close to his people,whether that means cuddling on the couch or proudly walking by your side.

Despite whatever he’s been through, Mako hasn’t lost his trust or his sweetness. He’s ready to trade survival mode for soft beds, warm blankets, and a family who will never let him feel alone again.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
